item_name: Rothco GI Type Stainless Steel Mess Kit
item_short_desc: Ideal for camping, survival, and outdoor adventures, Rothco's Stainless Steel Mess Kit is a versatile piece of compact cookware. This mess kit combines a fry pan and plate, making it perfect for any camping trip. Its 2-compartment plate is designed to easily fit into your backpack or rucksack, ensuring convenience on the go. Crafted from heavy-duty stainless steel, this camping cookware is both lightweight and durable, capable of withstanding the rigors of outdoor use.
